nodes.title: Afternoon coffee wrecks the next day
nodes.distillate_text: Cut it for three days — no change. This one is out.
nodes.body: Predicts: no afternoon coffee = better mornings. Tested and disconfirmed.

nodes.title: Three days off afternoon coffee: no improvement
nodes.distillate_text: A clean disconfirmation — the result the caffeine hypothesis predicted against.
nodes.body: This is what a real test looks like: a blocker that a hypothesis cannot survive.

nodes.title: Could it be low iron?
nodes.body: No position yet — an unknown to investigate, not a claim to defend. A blood test resolves it. Left open on purpose: its confidence is unset, and that is the honest state.

nodes.title: Big carby lunches cause the crash
nodes.distillate_text: Untested. A light-lunch week would isolate it — the next experiment to run.
nodes.body: Plausible and checkable. Confidence stays middling until the experiment runs.

nodes.title: Wiped out every afternoon by 2pm
nodes.distillate_text: A daily 2–4pm crash. "Tired" is too vague to fix — break it into suspects and test them one at a time.
nodes.body: The move is not to solve "tiredness" — it is to turn one fuzzy feeling into a few claims that each make a testable prediction.

nodes.title: Late screens push my sleep onset later
nodes.distillate_text: Overlaps with sleep debt, so hard to isolate alone. Untested as a standalone cause.
nodes.body: Note the entanglement: if this is true it may just be feeding sleep debt, not a separate cause.

nodes.title: Sleep debt — under 6.5h on weeknights
nodes.distillate_text: The weekday-only pattern fits this best. Leading suspect, but still unconfirmed — a week of tracking would settle it.
nodes.body: Fits the biggest clue (weekends are fine). Leading does not mean proven.

nodes.title: Protect a 7-hour sleep window; retest lunch next
nodes.distillate_text: Act on the leader (sleep debt) while queuing the next test (lunch). Do not declare victory yet.
nodes.body: A solution can be provisional: act on the best-supported claim without pretending the others are closed.

facets.name: pattern
facets.distillate: Only weekdays — weekends are fine. The single biggest clue.

facets.name: severity
facets.distillate: Need coffee or I am useless by 3pm.

edges.note: the weekday-only pattern points straight here
